    quote: "{\n  \"clause_id\": \"11.0\",\n  \"fragments\": [\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 22,\n      \"text\": \"\
      11.0    SHE Audit\\n\\n\\n11.1     General\\n\\n\\n11.1.1   The purpose and scope of SHE audit is to assess\
      \ potential risk, liabilities and the\\n         degree of compliance of construction Safety, Health and Environmental\
      \ plan and its\\n         supplementary  procedures and programs  against  applicable and  current SHE\\n\
      \           legalisation regulations and requirements of the employer.\\n\\n\\n11.1.2    Project Manager holds\
      \ the ultimate responsibility in ensuring implementation of SHE\\n          audit program during the construction\
      \ work.\\n\\n\\n11.2     Monthly Audit Rating Score (M A R S)\\n\\n\\n11.2.1   Monthly Audit Rating Score\
      \ (MARS) will be performed once in a month. A team\\n         consisting of Project manager and Employer representative\
      \ based on the pre-\\n        designed score-rating format will conduct  it. The details of the pre-designed\\\
      n        monthly audit score rating formats are given in the Project SHE manual.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"\
      pdf_page\": 23,\n      \"text\": \"11.2.2    This Monthly SHE Audit Rating Score (MARS) report will enable\
      \ the Employer to\\n                   evaluate the general compliance by the Contractor with the Conditions\
      \ of Contract, the\\n                  Employer’s Project SHE Manual and the Contractor’s site specific SHE\
      \ Plan.\\n\\n\\n          11.2.3   Monthly Audits  will be conducted in accordance with BMRC Guidelines. \
      \ The\\n                    Project Manager accompanied by the Employer’s representatives shall carry out\\\
      n                    the Audit. The Contractor’s senior manager and SHE in-charge should also be\\n      \
      \                invited to attend.\\n\\n\\n          11.2.4   Timing\\n\\n\\n                The Monthly\
      \ Audit Rating Score (MARS) should be conducted at least 7 days\\n                       prior to the scheduled\
      \ date of Monthly SHE Committee meeting.\\n\\n\\n          11.2.5   Evaluation\\n\\n\\n          11.2.5.1\
      \  The numerical scoring has been weighed on a 1-10 scale. The audit team will use\\n                    \
      \    their observations noted in evaluating the points to be awarded against each of\\n                  \
      \  the elements of the audited section. Wherever some topics and sub-topics are not\\n                   \
      \ applicable the score rating need not be given. The overall audit ratings shall be\\n                  achieved\
      \ by:\\n\\n\\n                    Overall Audit rating  =    Actual Score Achieved   X 100\\n\\n         \
      \                         Maximum Possible Score\\n\\n\\n          11.2.5.2  The criticality of the required\
      \ actions for the respective sections of the Audit will be\\n                      classified as:\\n\\n\\\
      n                          Sl.   Score          Description                          Action\\n           \
      \        No.\\n\\n                 1    < 60%   Immediate               Require Contractor to rectify within\
      \ 24\\n                                                          hours\\n\\n                 2    < 75%  \
      \ Improvement             Contractor rectification within 7 days and\\n                                Necessary\
      \               confirmed in writing to Employer\\n\\n                 3    < 90%   Improvement Desirable\
      \    Contractor rectification within one month\\n                                                    and confirmed\
      \ in writing to Employer\\n\\n\\n          11.2.6   Report\\n\\n              A copy of each Audit Report\
      \ will be sent to Employer and to all subcontractors,\\n                     with whom  it  will then be discussed\
      \ in detail at the Monthly SHE Committee\\n                  Meeting in order to ensure that any corrective\
      \ actions are agreed upon.\\n\\n\\n          11.3     Monthly Electrical Safety Audit\\n\\n\\n          11.3.1\
      \   A team comprising of contractor’s senior SHE (Electrical) engineer and Employer’s\\n                 \
      \   representative shall conduct monthly electrical safety audit covering the following and\\n           \
      \       submit the report to Employer.\\n\\n\\n                                 i)     Electrical accidents\
      \ investigation findings and remedy\\n\\n                                    ii)   Adequacy of power generation\
      \ and power requirements\\n\\n                                     iii)   Power distribution and transmission\
      \ system in place\\n\\n                          iv)   Updated electrical single line diagram showing the\
      \ current condition of power\\n                        source and distribution including the IP44 DBs arrangement.\\\
      n\\n                      v)     Electrical protection devices – selection, installation and maintenance.\\\
      n\\n                          vi)   Earth or ground connection and earth pit maintenance details\"\n    },\n\
      \    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 24,\n      \"text\": \"vii)   Education and training of electrical personnel undertaken\\\
      n\\n               viii)  Routine electrical inspection details\\n\\n             ix)    Electrical maintenance\
      \ system and register.\\n\\n           x)   Name plate details of major electrical equipment\\n\\n       \
      \      xi)    Classified zones in the site, if any.\\n\\n11.4   External SHE Audi\\n\\n\\n11.4.1    External\
      \ SHE audits are  to be conducted by  external agencies  that are\\n        competent with ISO qualified auditors\
      \ with the prior approval of the Employer.\\n\\n\\n11.4.2   Areas of competence of Audit team\\n\\n\\n11.4.2.1\
      \  Practical understanding of BOCW Act and Rules, statutory requirements on\\n         health/medical and\
      \ welfare of workmen, construction hazards and its prevention\\n        and control, traffic management, electrical\
      \ safety, rigging, safety of construction\\n        equipment and environment management.\\n\\n\\n11.4.2.2\
      \  Audit shall be conducted as per the guidelines of ISO, ILO, and national\\n         standards. Audit report\
      \ shall also be presented as per the above formats.\\n\\n\\n11.4.3    External SHE audit shall be conducted\
      \ on a quarterly basis throughout the\\n         currency of the contract.\\n\\n\\n11.4.4    Targets of SHE\
      \ Audit:\\n\\n\\n        The contents and coverage of the external audit shall include the following items\\\
      n\\n\\n11.4.4.1 SHE management:\\n\\n\\n                i)     Organization\\n\\n                  ii)   \
      \ Communication and Motivation\\n\\n                  iii)   Time office\\n\\n             iv)    Inspection\\\
      n\\n           v)   Emergency preparedness\\n\\n             vi)   Budget allocation\\n\\n              vii)\
      \   Education and Training\\n\\n               viii)  Work permit system\\n\\n\\n11.4.4.2  Technical:\\n\\\
      n\\n                i)     Building and Structure\\n\\n                  ii)    Construction operational safety\\\
      n\\n                  iii)    Material safety\\n\\n             iv)   Hand tools and Power tools\\n\\n   \
      \        v)     Electrical system\\n\\n             vi)    Safety Appliances\\n\\n              vii)   Fire\
      \ prevention and control\\n\\n               viii)  Housekeeping\\n\\n             ix)   Maintenance and Machinery\
      \ safety\\n\\n           x)     First-aid and Medical Facilities\\n\\n             xi)   Welfare measures\\\
      n\\n              xii)   Environmental Management\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 25,\n      \"text\"\
      : \"11.4.5   Audit Documents:\\n\\n\\n          11.4.5.1  Contractor shall make the below listed documents\
      \ available for the review by\\n                  the Audit team.\\n\\n\\n                               \
      \  i)   SHE policy\\n\\n                                    ii)   SHE manual\\n\\n                       \
      \              iii)   SHE Rules and Regulation\\n\\n                          iv)  SHE organization chart\\\
      n\\n                      v)    Annual SHE objectives / programs\\n\\n                          vi)   Accident\
      \ / near miss statistics and analysis\\n\\n                             vii)  SHE Training program / records\
      \ for all personnel\\n\\n                               viii)  Operating manuals and maintenance manual of\
      \ all equipments\\n\\n                          ix)   Safe worthiness certificates of all lifting appliances\
      \ and gears\\n\\n                      x)    Medical fitness record for all personnel\\n\\n              \
      \            xi)   Risk identification, assessment and control details\\n\\n                             xii)\
      \   Environmental management reports\\n\\n                               xiii)  Emergency management records\
      \ including mock drill\\n\\n\\n          11.4.6    Audit Preparation:\\n\\n\\n                           \
      \      i)     Audit team members are required to gather information by observations through\\n           \
      \                interviews and by checks of hardware and documentation.\\n\\n                           \
      \         ii)    Audit team shall prepare checklist to cover all parts based on SHE legislations\\n      \
      \                     rules and regulations and BMRC requirements.\\n\\n                                 \
      \    iii)    Audit team members shall verify the facts and findings leading to the identified\\n         \
      \             gaps and weakness.\\n\\n                          iv)    Audit leader has overall responsibility\
      \ for reaching a conclusion.\\n\\n\\n          11.4.7    Reporting:\\n\\n\\n          11.4.7.1  Audit report\
      \ shall be prepared and directly sent to the Employer within 7 days of\\n                   conducting the\
      \ audit with a copy to the contractor.\\n\\n\\n          11.4.8   Report contents:\\n\\n\\n              \
      \                   i)    Executing summary - based on the finalized checklists as written the findings to\\\
      n                          the Employer by the audit team members, the audit leader  will compile a\\n   \
      \                     concise and accurate summary of observations and findings.\\n\\n                   \
      \                 ii)    Introduction  -  this  will contain basic information regarding the  facilities or\\\
      n                          organization audited, the specific audit dates (inclusion of those for preparation\\\
      n                     and post-audit activities).\\n\\n                                     iii)    Principal\
      \ positive findings - This will contain the summary of positive aspects as\\n                       observed\
      \ by the auditors.   It will also contain highlights of those issue, which\\n                   may warrant\
      \ dissemination as best practice regarding methodology used or\\n                        achievement.\\n\\\
      n\\n                          iv)    Audit Findings - All audit findings as detailed in the audit checklists\
      \ shall be\\n                       grouped together as priority 1 and 2 as detailed below in a separate listing.\\\
      n\\n                          a)      Priority  1: Actions  to  rectify gaps or weakness should generally\
      \ be\\n                            implemented within 2 – weeks, if risk potential is high or unacceptable.\\\
      n\\n                          b)      Priority 2: Actions should be generally implemented or rectified with\
      \ a\\n                       maximum of 3 – 4 weeks, if not rectified would create a likelihood of minor\\\
      n                                    injury or business loss.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 26,\n\
      \      \"text\": \"11.4.9    Conformity Report & Action by Employer\\n\\n\\n11.4.9.1  The auditor shall inspect\
      \ the site after 14 days of conducting initial audit for checking\\n          the adequacy of implementation\
      \ of items maintained under priority 1 by the contractor\\n        and shall submit a conformity / non-conformity\
      \ report to the Employer with a copy to the\\n          contractor.\\n\\n\\n11.4.9.2  The auditor shall again\
      \ inspect after 28 days of conducting initial audit for checking the\\n        adequacy of implementation\
      \ of items mentioned under priority 2 by the contractor and\\n           shall submit a conformity / non-conformity\
      \ report to the Employer with a copy to the\\n          contractor.\\n\\n\\n11.4.9.3  In case of non-conformity\
      \ of items mentioned by auditor, the Employer shall take\\n         necessary steps including stoppage of\
      \ work and or imposing any penalty for getting the\\n          item implemented.\\n\\n\\n11.4.10   Failure\
      \ of contractor to conduct External SHE Audit\\n\\n\\n11.4.10.1 If the contractor fails to conduct the external\
      \ SHE audit in time, the Employer at\\n         the cost of contractor shall get it done.\"\n    }\n  ],\n\

    quote: "{\n  \"clause_id\": \"14.0\",\n  \"fragments\": [\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 27,\n      \"text\": \"\
      14.0     Accident reporting and investigation\\n\\n\\n          14.1     Reporting to Employer\\n\\n\\n  \
      \        14.1.1    All accidents and dangerous occurrences  shall immediately be informed\\n             \
      \      verbally to the Employer. This will enable the Employer to reach to the scene of\\n               \
      \   accident  / dangerous occurrences to monitor/assist any rescue work and/or\\n                     start\
      \ conducting the investigation process so that the evidences are not lost.\\n\\n\\n          14.1.2   Reports\
      \ of all accidents (fatal / injury) and dangerous occurrences shall also be\\n                  sent within\
      \ 24 hours as per format provided in the Employer’s Project SHE\\n                 manual.\\n\\n         \
      \ 14.1.3   No accident   / dangerous occurrences  is exempted from reporting to the\\n                 Employer.\\\
      n\\n\\n          14.1.4   Any wilful delay in verbal and written reporting to the Employer shall be\\n   \
      \               penalised as per relevant clause.\\n\\n\\n          14.2     Reporting to Govt. organisations\"\
      \n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 28,\n      \"text\": \"14.2.1    In addition to the above verbal and\
      \ written reporting to the Employer, as per Rule 210\\n           of BOCWR, notice of any accident to a worker\
      \ at the building or construction site that:\\n\\n\\n          a)   causes loss of life; or\\n\\n        \
      \  b)    disables a worker from working for a period of 48 hours or more immediately\\n                 following\
      \ the accident;\\n\\n           c)     shall forthwith be sent by telegram, telephone, fax, or similar other\
      \ means\\n                including special messenger within four hours in case of fatal accidents and 72\\\
      n              hours in case of other accidents, to:\\n\\n                          i)     the Regional Labour\
      \ Commissioner, wherein the contractor has registered\\n                     the firm/work\\n\\n         \
      \                   ii)    the board with which the worker involved was registered as a beneficiary;\\n\\\
      n                             iii)    Director General and\\n\\n                     iv)    the next of kin\
      \ or other relative of the worker involved in the accident;\\n\\n\\n14.2.2    Further, notice of accident\
      \ shall be sent in respect of an accident which\\n\\n\\n          a)   causes loss of life; or\\n\\n     \
      \     b)    disables the injured worker from work for more than 10 days to\\n\\n                         \
      \ i)     the officer-in-charge of the nearest police station;\\n\\n                            ii)    the\
      \ District Magistrate or, if the District Magistrate by order so desires, to\\n\\n                       \
      \      iii)    the Sub-Divisional Magistrate\\n\\n\\n14.2.3    In case of an accident causing minor injury,\
      \ first-aid shall be administered and the\\n           injured worker shall be immediately transferred to\
      \ a hospital or other place for medical\\n          treatment.\\n\\n14.2.4   Where any accident causing disablement\
      \ that subsequently results in death, notice in\\n           writing of such death, shall be sent to the authorities\
      \ mentioned in clause 14.2.1 and\\n          14.2.2 above within 72 hours of such death.\\n\\n\\n14.2.5  \
      \  Reporting of dangerous occurrences:\\n\\n\\n14.2.5.1  The following classes of dangerous occurrences shall\
      \ be reported to the Inspector\\n         having jurisdiction, whether or not any disablement or death caused\
      \ to the worker,\\n         namely:\\n\\n\\n          a)    collapse or  failure  of  lifting appliances,\
      \  or  hoist,  or conveyors, or  similar\\n              equipment for handling of building or construction\
      \ material or breakage or failure\\n                 of rope, chain or loose gears; or overturning of cranes\
      \ used in construction\\n               work;\\n\\n          b)     falling of objects from height;\\n\\n\
      \           c)    collapse or subsidence of soil, tunnel, pipe lines, any wall, floor, gallery, roof or\\\
      n             any other part of any structure, launching girder, platform, staging, scaffolding or\\n    \
      \        means of access including formwork;\\n\\n          d)    explosion of receiver or vessel used  for\
      \ storage of pressure greater than\\n               atmospheric pressure, of any gas or gases or any liquid\
      \ or solid used as\\n                 building material;\\n\\n          e)     fire and explosion causing\
      \ damage to any place on construction site where\\n                 building workers are employed;\\n\\n \
      \              f)     spillage or leakage of any hazardous substance and damage to their container;\\n\\n\
      \          g)    collapse, capsizing, toppling or collision of transport equipment;\\n\\n          h)    leakage\
      \ or release of harmful toxic gases at the construction site;\\n\\n\\n14.2.6    In case of failure of launching\
      \ girder, lifting appliance, loose gear, hoist or building and\\n          other construction work, machinery\
      \ and transport equipment at a construction site,\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"text\"\
      : \"such appliances, gear, hoist, machinery or equipment and the site of such occurrence\\n              \
      \         shall, as far as practicable, be kept undisturbed until inspected by the Authorities;\\n\\n\\n \
      \         14.2.7   Every notice given for fatal accidents or dangerous occurrences shall be followed by a\\\
      n                      written report to the concerned Authorities under Section 39 of BOCWA and the\\n  \
      \                   Director General in the specified Form XIV of BOCWR.\\n\\n\\n          14.3     Accident\
      \ investigation\\n\\n\\n          14.3.1   General\\n\\n\\n          14.3.1.1  Investigations  should be \
      \ conducted  in an open and  positive atmosphere  that\\n                 encourages the witnesses to talk\
      \ freely. The primary objective is to ascertain the facts\\n                     with a view to prevent future\
      \ and possibly more serious occurrences\\n\\n\\n          14.3.1.2  Accidents and Dangerous Occurrences which\
      \ result in death, serious injury or serious\\n               damage must be investigated by the Contractor\
      \ immediately to find out the cause of the\\n                   accident/occurrence so that measures can be\
      \ formulated to prevent any recurrence.\\n\\n\\n          14.3.1.3  Near misses and minor accidents should\
      \ also be investigated by the Contractor as\\n                 soon as possible as they are signals  that\
      \ there are inadequacies  in the safety\\n                management system.\\n\\n\\n          14.3.2   Procedure\
      \ of incident investigation\\n\\n\\n          14.3.2.1   It is important after any accident or dangerous occurrence\
      \ that information relating to\\n                    the incident is gathered in an organised way. The following\
      \ steps shall be followed;\\n\\n                     a)    take photographs and make sketches\\n\\n      \
      \               b)   examine involved equipment, workplace  or  material and the environmental\\n        \
      \                  conditions\\n\\n                      c)    interview the injured, eye-witnesses and other\
      \ involved parties\\n\\n                     d)    consult expert opinion where necessary\\n\\n          \
      \           e)    identify the specific contractor or sub-contractor involved.\\n\\n\\n          14.3.2.2\
      \  Having gathered information, it is then necessary to make an analysis of incident\\n\\n               \
      \      a)    establish the chain of events leading to the accident or incident\\n\\n                     b)\
      \    find out at what stage the accident took place\\n\\n                      c)    consider all possible\
      \ causes and the interaction of different factors that led up to\\n                         the accident,\
      \ and identify the most probable cause The cause of an accident\\n                        should never be\
      \ classified as carelessness. The specific act or omission that\\n                      caused the accident\
      \ must be identified.\\n\\n\\n          14.3.2.3  The next stage is to proceed with the follow-up action\\\
      n\\n                     a)    report on the findings and conclusions\\n\\n                     b)    formulate\
      \ preventive measures to avoid recurrence\\n\\n                      c)    publicise the findings and the\
      \ remedial actions taken\\n\\n\\n          14.4     Employers’ independent incident investigation\\n\\n\\\
      n          14.4.1    In case of fatal / dangerous occurrence the Employer shall also conduct independent\\\
      n                      investigation. Contractor and his staff shall extend necessary co-operation and testify\\\
      n                  about the accident.\\n\\n\\n          14.4.2   The contractor shall take every effort to\
      \ preserve the scene of accident till the Employer\\n                  completes the investigation.\"\n  \
      \  },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 30,\n      \"text\": \"14.4.3     All persons summoned by the Employer in\
      \ connection to witness recording shall obey\\n          the instructions without delay. Any wilful suppression\
      \ of information by any person shall\\n        be removed from the site immediately and  / or punishable as\
      \ per relevant penalty\\n          clause.\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"heading_line\": \"          14.0     Accident\
      \ reporting and investigation\",\n  \"retained_lines\": [\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 27,\n      \"source_line_number\"\

      \"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 7,\n      \"text\": \"         \

      : 10,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 11,\n \
      \     \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 12,\n      \"\
      text\": \"          14.3     Accident investigation\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\"\
      : 13,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 14,\n \
      \     \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 15,\n      \"\
      text\": \"          14.3.1   General\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\"\
      : 16,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 17,\n \
      \     \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 18,\n      \"\
      text\": \"          14.3.1.1  Investigations  should be  conducted  in an open and  positive atmosphere  that\"\
      \n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 19,\n      \"text\": \"          \
      \       encourages the witnesses to talk freely. The primary objective is to ascertain the facts\"\n    },\n\
      \    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 20,\n      \"text\": \"                   \
      \  with a view to prevent future and possibly more serious occurrences\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\"\
      : 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 21,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n \
      \     \"source_line_number\": 22,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"\
      source_line_number\": 23,\n      \"text\": \"          14.3.1.2  Accidents and Dangerous Occurrences which\
      \ result in death, serious injury or serious\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\"\
      : 24,\n      \"text\": \"               damage must be investigated by the Contractor immediately to find\
      \ out the cause of the\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 25,\n    \
      \  \"text\": \"                   accident/occurrence so that measures can be formulated to prevent any recurrence.\"\
      \n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 26,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n\
      \    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 27,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n\
      \      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 28,\n      \"text\": \"          14.3.1.3  Near misses\
      \ and minor accidents should also be investigated by the Contractor as\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\"\
      : 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 29,\n      \"text\": \"                 soon as possible as they are\
      \ signals  that there are inadequacies  in the safety\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"\
      source_line_number\": 30,\n      \"text\": \"                management system.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"\
      pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 31,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\"\
      : 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 32,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n \
      \     \"source_line_number\": 33,\n      \"text\": \"          14.3.2   Procedure of incident investigation\"\
      \n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 34,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n\
      \    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 35,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n\
      \      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 36,\n      \"text\": \"          14.3.2.1   It is\
      \ important after any accident or dangerous occurrence that information relating to\"\n    },\n    {\n   \
      \   \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 37,\n      \"text\": \"                    the incident\
      \ is gathered in an organised way. The following steps shall be followed;\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\"\
      : 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 38,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n \
      \     \"source_line_number\": 39,\n      \"text\": \"                     a)    take photographs and make\
      \ sketches\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 40,\n      \"text\": \"\
      \"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 41,\n      \"text\": \"        \
      \             b)   examine involved equipment, workplace  or  material and the environmental\"\n    },\n \
      \   {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 42,\n      \"text\": \"                    \
      \      conditions\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 43,\n      \"text\"\
      : \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 44,\n      \"text\": \"    \
      \                  c)    interview the injured, eye-witnesses and other involved parties\"\n    },\n    {\n\
      \      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 45,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"\
      pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 46,\n      \"text\": \"                     d)    consult expert\
      \ opinion where necessary\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 47,\n \
      \     \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 48,\n      \"\
      text\": \"                     e)    identify the specific contractor or sub-contractor involved.\"\n    },\n\
      \    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 49,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n\
      \      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 50,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"\
      pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 51,\n      \"text\": \"          14.3.2.2  Having gathered\
      \ information, it is then necessary to make an analysis of incident\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\":\
      \ 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 52,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n \
      \     \"source_line_number\": 53,\n      \"text\": \"                     a)    establish the chain of events\
      \ leading to the accident or incident\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\"\
      : 54,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 55,\n \
      \     \"text\": \"                     b)    find out at what stage the accident took place\"\n    },\n  \
      \  {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 56,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n  \
      \    \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 57,\n      \"text\": \"                      c)    consider\
      \ all possible causes and the interaction of different factors that led up to\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\"\
      : 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 58,\n      \"text\": \"                         the accident, and identify\
      \ the most probable cause The cause of an accident\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\"\
      : 59,\n      \"text\": \"                        should never be classified as carelessness. The specific\
      \ act or omission that\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 60,\n    \
      \  \"text\": \"                      caused the accident must be identified.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\"\
      : 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 61,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n \
      \     \"source_line_number\": 62,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"\
      source_line_number\": 63,\n      \"text\": \"          14.3.2.3  The next stage is to proceed with the follow-up\
      \ action\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 64,\n      \"text\": \"\"\
      \n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 65,\n      \"text\": \"          \
      \           a)    report on the findings and conclusions\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n     \
      \ \"source_line_number\": 66,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\"\
      : 67,\n      \"text\": \"                     b)    formulate preventive measures to avoid recurrence\"\n\
      \    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 68,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n\
      \    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 69,\n      \"text\": \"                   \
      \   c)    publicise the findings and the remedial actions taken\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n\
      \      \"source_line_number\": 70,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"\
      source_line_number\": 71,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\"\
      : 72,\n      \"text\": \"          14.4     Employers’ independent incident investigation\"\n    },\n    {\n\
      \      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 73,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"\
      pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 74,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\"\
      : 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 75,\n      \"text\": \"          14.4.1    In case of fatal / dangerous\
      \ occurrence the Employer shall also conduct independent\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n     \
      \ \"source_line_number\": 76,\n      \"text\": \"                      investigation. Contractor and his staff\
      \ shall extend necessary co-operation and testify\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\"\
      : 77,\n      \"text\": \"                  about the accident.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n\
      \      \"source_line_number\": 78,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"\
      source_line_number\": 79,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\"\
      : 80,\n      \"text\": \"          14.4.2   The contractor shall take every effort to preserve the scene of\
      \ accident till the Employer\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 81,\n\
      \      \"text\": \"                  completes the investigation.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n\
      \      \"source_line_number\": 82,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"\
      source_line_number\": 83,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\"\
      : 84,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 85,\n \
      \     \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 30,\n      \"source_line_number\": 3,\n      \"text\"\
      : \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 30,\n      \"source_line_number\": 4,\n      \"text\": \"14.4.3\
      \     All persons summoned by the Employer in connection to witness recording shall obey\"\n    },\n    {\n\
      \      \"pdf_page\": 30,\n      \"source_line_number\": 5,\n      \"text\": \"          the instructions without\

      13.0    SHE Submittals to the Employer\\n\\n\\n13.1    The contractor’s SHE management should send the following\
      \ reports to the Employer\\n           periodically:\\n\\n                i)     Daily Reporting of total\
      \ no of workmen (as given in Clause 13.2 )\\n\\n                  ii)    Monthly SHE Report (as given in Clause\
      \ 13.3 )\\n\\n                  iii)   SHE Committee Meeting Minutes (as given in Clause 7.9.1)\\n\\n    \
      \         iv)  SHE Inspection Reports\\n\\n           v)   SHE Audit Reports\\n\\n                a)    Monthly\
      \ Audit Rating Score (MARS) report\\n\\n                b)    External SHE Audit\\n\\n                 c)\
      \     Electrical Safety Audit\\n\\n             vi)    Air and Noise Quality monitoring report\\n\\n\\n13.2\
      \     Daily Reporting of total number of workmen\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 27,\n      \"text\"\
      : \"13.2.1   The contractor shall report to the Employer the total number of workmen\\n                engaged\
      \ by all including any subcontractor within 2 hours of starting of any\\n                      shift in any\
      \ day. This reporting shall be the primary duty of the Chief SHE\\n               Manager of the contractor\
      \ and reporting shall be through tele-fax / email. The\\n               onus of checking the receipt of the\
      \ same by the Employer  lies with the\\n                   contractor. If the information is not received\
      \ or received more than 2 hrs after\\n                    starting of the shift, penalty shall be levied as\
      \ per relevant clause.\\n\\n\\n          13.3     Monthly SHE Report\\n\\n\\n          13.3.1   The contractor\
      \ shall prepare a monthly SHE report consisting of the following and\\n                  submit 3 copies within\
      \ 7th of next month to the Employer as specified in the Project\\n             SHE manual.\\n\\n\\n      \
      \                           i)    Monthly man-hour details as specified in the Project SHE manual\\n\\n  \
      \                                  ii)    Monthly accident / incident details as specified in the Project\
      \ SHE manual\\n\\n                                     iii)   SHE committee details\\n\\n                \
      \          iv)    Details of SHE training conducted in the month\\n\\n                      v)   SHE Inspection\\\
      n\\n                          vi)  SHE internal audit details like electrical audit etc.\\n\\n           \
      \                  vii)  SHE Communication activities under taken in the month indicating the number\\n  \
      \                          of posters displayed and balance availability in stock.\\n\\n                 \
      \              viii)   Air quality / Noise monitoring details\\n\\n                          ix)   Toolbox\
      \ talks details\\n\\n                      x)   PPE details: Quantity purchased, issued to the workmen and\
      \ stock available.\\n\\n                          xi)    Details on IP 44 panel boards, lighting poles, welding\
      \ and cutting equipments,\\n                        Ladders, Hoists, tools & tackles.\\n\\n              \
      \               xii)   Monthly Lux meter study results\\n\\n                               xiii)  Housekeeping\\\
      n\\n                        xiv)  Barricade maintenance details\\n\\n                     xv)  No of critical\
      \ excavations\\n\\n                        xvi)  Health & Welfare activities\\n\\n                       \
      \   xvii)  Safety walk conducted by Contractors’ Project Manager in the month\\n\\n                      \
      \     xviii) SHE Activities Planned for next month\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"heading_line\": \"13.0    SHE Submittals\

      \ reports to the Employer\\n           periodically:\\n\\n                i)     Daily Reporting of total\
      \ no of workmen (as given in Clause 13.2 )\\n\\n                  ii)    Monthly SHE Report (as given in Clause\
      \ 13.3 )\\n\\n                  iii)   SHE Committee Meeting Minutes (as given in Clause 7.9.1)\\n\\n    \
      \         iv)  SHE Inspection Reports\\n\\n           v)   SHE Audit Reports\\n\\n                a)    Monthly\

      \     Daily Reporting of total number of workmen\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 27,\n      \"text\"\

    quote: "{\n  \"clause_id\": \"14.0\",\n  \"fragments\": [\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 27,\n      \"text\": \"\
      14.0     Accident reporting and investigation\\n\\n\\n          14.1     Reporting to Employer\\n\\n\\n  \
      \        14.1.1    All accidents and dangerous occurrences  shall immediately be informed\\n             \
      \      verbally to the Employer. This will enable the Employer to reach to the scene of\\n               \
      \   accident  / dangerous occurrences to monitor/assist any rescue work and/or\\n                     start\
      \ conducting the investigation process so that the evidences are not lost.\\n\\n\\n          14.1.2   Reports\
      \ of all accidents (fatal / injury) and dangerous occurrences shall also be\\n                  sent within\
      \ 24 hours as per format provided in the Employer’s Project SHE\\n                 manual.\\n\\n         \
      \ 14.1.3   No accident   / dangerous occurrences  is exempted from reporting to the\\n                 Employer.\\\
      n\\n\\n          14.1.4   Any wilful delay in verbal and written reporting to the Employer shall be\\n   \
      \               penalised as per relevant clause.\\n\\n\\n          14.2     Reporting to Govt. organisations\"\
      \n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 28,\n      \"text\": \"14.2.1    In addition to the above verbal and\
      \ written reporting to the Employer, as per Rule 210\\n           of BOCWR, notice of any accident to a worker\
      \ at the building or construction site that:\\n\\n\\n          a)   causes loss of life; or\\n\\n        \
      \  b)    disables a worker from working for a period of 48 hours or more immediately\\n                 following\
      \ the accident;\\n\\n           c)     shall forthwith be sent by telegram, telephone, fax, or similar other\
      \ means\\n                including special messenger within four hours in case of fatal accidents and 72\\\
      n              hours in case of other accidents, to:\\n\\n                          i)     the Regional Labour\
      \ Commissioner, wherein the contractor has registered\\n                     the firm/work\\n\\n         \
      \                   ii)    the board with which the worker involved was registered as a beneficiary;\\n\\\
      n                             iii)    Director General and\\n\\n                     iv)    the next of kin\
      \ or other relative of the worker involved in the accident;\\n\\n\\n14.2.2    Further, notice of accident\
      \ shall be sent in respect of an accident which\\n\\n\\n          a)   causes loss of life; or\\n\\n     \
      \     b)    disables the injured worker from work for more than 10 days to\\n\\n                         \
      \ i)     the officer-in-charge of the nearest police station;\\n\\n                            ii)    the\
      \ District Magistrate or, if the District Magistrate by order so desires, to\\n\\n                       \
      \      iii)    the Sub-Divisional Magistrate\\n\\n\\n14.2.3    In case of an accident causing minor injury,\
      \ first-aid shall be administered and the\\n           injured worker shall be immediately transferred to\
      \ a hospital or other place for medical\\n          treatment.\\n\\n14.2.4   Where any accident causing disablement\
      \ that subsequently results in death, notice in\\n           writing of such death, shall be sent to the authorities\
      \ mentioned in clause 14.2.1 and\\n          14.2.2 above within 72 hours of such death.\\n\\n\\n14.2.5  \
      \  Reporting of dangerous occurrences:\\n\\n\\n14.2.5.1  The following classes of dangerous occurrences shall\
      \ be reported to the Inspector\\n         having jurisdiction, whether or not any disablement or death caused\
      \ to the worker,\\n         namely:\\n\\n\\n          a)    collapse or  failure  of  lifting appliances,\
      \  or  hoist,  or conveyors, or  similar\\n              equipment for handling of building or construction\
      \ material or breakage or failure\\n                 of rope, chain or loose gears; or overturning of cranes\
      \ used in construction\\n               work;\\n\\n          b)     falling of objects from height;\\n\\n\
      \           c)    collapse or subsidence of soil, tunnel, pipe lines, any wall, floor, gallery, roof or\\\
      n             any other part of any structure, launching girder, platform, staging, scaffolding or\\n    \
      \        means of access including formwork;\\n\\n          d)    explosion of receiver or vessel used  for\
      \ storage of pressure greater than\\n               atmospheric pressure, of any gas or gases or any liquid\
      \ or solid used as\\n                 building material;\\n\\n          e)     fire and explosion causing\
      \ damage to any place on construction site where\\n                 building workers are employed;\\n\\n \
      \              f)     spillage or leakage of any hazardous substance and damage to their container;\\n\\n\
      \          g)    collapse, capsizing, toppling or collision of transport equipment;\\n\\n          h)    leakage\
      \ or release of harmful toxic gases at the construction site;\\n\\n\\n14.2.6    In case of failure of launching\
      \ girder, lifting appliance, loose gear, hoist or building and\\n          other construction work, machinery\
      \ and transport equipment at a construction site,\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"text\"\
      : \"such appliances, gear, hoist, machinery or equipment and the site of such occurrence\\n              \
      \         shall, as far as practicable, be kept undisturbed until inspected by the Authorities;\\n\\n\\n \
      \         14.2.7   Every notice given for fatal accidents or dangerous occurrences shall be followed by a\\\
      n                      written report to the concerned Authorities under Section 39 of BOCWA and the\\n  \
      \                   Director General in the specified Form XIV of BOCWR.\\n\\n\\n          14.3     Accident\
      \ investigation\\n\\n\\n          14.3.1   General\\n\\n\\n          14.3.1.1  Investigations  should be \
      \ conducted  in an open and  positive atmosphere  that\\n                 encourages the witnesses to talk\
      \ freely. The primary objective is to ascertain the facts\\n                     with a view to prevent future\
      \ and possibly more serious occurrences\\n\\n\\n          14.3.1.2  Accidents and Dangerous Occurrences which\
      \ result in death, serious injury or serious\\n               damage must be investigated by the Contractor\
      \ immediately to find out the cause of the\\n                   accident/occurrence so that measures can be\
      \ formulated to prevent any recurrence.\\n\\n\\n          14.3.1.3  Near misses and minor accidents should\
      \ also be investigated by the Contractor as\\n                 soon as possible as they are signals  that\
      \ there are inadequacies  in the safety\\n                management system.\\n\\n\\n          14.3.2   Procedure\
      \ of incident investigation\\n\\n\\n          14.3.2.1   It is important after any accident or dangerous occurrence\
      \ that information relating to\\n                    the incident is gathered in an organised way. The following\
      \ steps shall be followed;\\n\\n                     a)    take photographs and make sketches\\n\\n      \
      \               b)   examine involved equipment, workplace  or  material and the environmental\\n        \
      \                  conditions\\n\\n                      c)    interview the injured, eye-witnesses and other\
      \ involved parties\\n\\n                     d)    consult expert opinion where necessary\\n\\n          \
      \           e)    identify the specific contractor or sub-contractor involved.\\n\\n\\n          14.3.2.2\
      \  Having gathered information, it is then necessary to make an analysis of incident\\n\\n               \
      \      a)    establish the chain of events leading to the accident or incident\\n\\n                     b)\
      \    find out at what stage the accident took place\\n\\n                      c)    consider all possible\
      \ causes and the interaction of different factors that led up to\\n                         the accident,\
      \ and identify the most probable cause The cause of an accident\\n                        should never be\
      \ classified as carelessness. The specific act or omission that\\n                      caused the accident\
      \ must be identified.\\n\\n\\n          14.3.2.3  The next stage is to proceed with the follow-up action\\\
      n\\n                     a)    report on the findings and conclusions\\n\\n                     b)    formulate\
      \ preventive measures to avoid recurrence\\n\\n                      c)    publicise the findings and the\
      \ remedial actions taken\\n\\n\\n          14.4     Employers’ independent incident investigation\\n\\n\\\
      n          14.4.1    In case of fatal / dangerous occurrence the Employer shall also conduct independent\\\
      n                      investigation. Contractor and his staff shall extend necessary co-operation and testify\\\
      n                  about the accident.\\n\\n\\n          14.4.2   The contractor shall take every effort to\
      \ preserve the scene of accident till the Employer\\n                  completes the investigation.\"\n  \
      \  },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 30,\n      \"text\": \"14.4.3     All persons summoned by the Employer in\
      \ connection to witness recording shall obey\\n          the instructions without delay. Any wilful suppression\
      \ of information by any person shall\\n        be removed from the site immediately and  / or punishable as\
      \ per relevant penalty\\n          clause.\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"heading_line\": \"          14.0     Accident\
      \ reporting and investigation\",\n  \"retained_lines\": [\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 27,\n      \"source_line_number\"\

      \"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 7,\n      \"text\": \"         \
      \ 14.2.7   Every notice given for fatal accidents or dangerous occurrences shall be followed by a\"\n    },\n\
      \    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 8,\n      \"text\": \"                    \

      : 10,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 11,\n \
      \     \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 12,\n      \"\
      text\": \"          14.3     Accident investigation\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\"\
      : 13,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 14,\n \
      \     \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 15,\n      \"\
      text\": \"          14.3.1   General\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\"\
      : 16,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 17,\n \
      \     \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 18,\n      \"\
      text\": \"          14.3.1.1  Investigations  should be  conducted  in an open and  positive atmosphere  that\"\
      \n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 19,\n      \"text\": \"          \
      \       encourages the witnesses to talk freely. The primary objective is to ascertain the facts\"\n    },\n\
      \    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 20,\n      \"text\": \"                   \
      \  with a view to prevent future and possibly more serious occurrences\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\"\
      : 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 21,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n \
      \     \"source_line_number\": 22,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"\
      source_line_number\": 23,\n      \"text\": \"          14.3.1.2  Accidents and Dangerous Occurrences which\
      \ result in death, serious injury or serious\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\"\
      : 24,\n      \"text\": \"               damage must be investigated by the Contractor immediately to find\
      \ out the cause of the\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 25,\n    \
      \  \"text\": \"                   accident/occurrence so that measures can be formulated to prevent any recurrence.\"\
      \n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 26,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n\
      \    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 27,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n\
      \      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 28,\n      \"text\": \"          14.3.1.3  Near misses\
      \ and minor accidents should also be investigated by the Contractor as\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\"\
      : 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 29,\n      \"text\": \"                 soon as possible as they are\
      \ signals  that there are inadequacies  in the safety\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"\
      source_line_number\": 30,\n      \"text\": \"                management system.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"\
      pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 31,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\"\
      : 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 32,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n \
      \     \"source_line_number\": 33,\n      \"text\": \"          14.3.2   Procedure of incident investigation\"\
      \n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 34,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n\
      \    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 35,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n\
      \      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 36,\n      \"text\": \"          14.3.2.1   It is\
      \ important after any accident or dangerous occurrence that information relating to\"\n    },\n    {\n   \
      \   \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 37,\n      \"text\": \"                    the incident\
      \ is gathered in an organised way. The following steps shall be followed;\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\"\
      : 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 38,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n \
      \     \"source_line_number\": 39,\n      \"text\": \"                     a)    take photographs and make\
      \ sketches\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 40,\n      \"text\": \"\
      \"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 41,\n      \"text\": \"        \
      \             b)   examine involved equipment, workplace  or  material and the environmental\"\n    },\n \
      \   {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 42,\n      \"text\": \"                    \
      \      conditions\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 43,\n      \"text\"\
      : \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 44,\n      \"text\": \"    \
      \                  c)    interview the injured, eye-witnesses and other involved parties\"\n    },\n    {\n\
      \      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 45,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"\
      pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 46,\n      \"text\": \"                     d)    consult expert\
      \ opinion where necessary\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 47,\n \
      \     \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 48,\n      \"\
      text\": \"                     e)    identify the specific contractor or sub-contractor involved.\"\n    },\n\
      \    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 49,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n\
      \      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 50,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"\
      pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 51,\n      \"text\": \"          14.3.2.2  Having gathered\
      \ information, it is then necessary to make an analysis of incident\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\":\
      \ 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 52,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n \
      \     \"source_line_number\": 53,\n      \"text\": \"                     a)    establish the chain of events\
      \ leading to the accident or incident\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\"\
      : 54,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 55,\n \
      \     \"text\": \"                     b)    find out at what stage the accident took place\"\n    },\n  \
      \  {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 56,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n  \
      \    \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 57,\n      \"text\": \"                      c)    consider\
      \ all possible causes and the interaction of different factors that led up to\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\"\
      : 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 58,\n      \"text\": \"                         the accident, and identify\
      \ the most probable cause The cause of an accident\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\"\
      : 59,\n      \"text\": \"                        should never be classified as carelessness. The specific\
      \ act or omission that\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 60,\n    \
      \  \"text\": \"                      caused the accident must be identified.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\"\
      : 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 61,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n \
      \     \"source_line_number\": 62,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"\
      source_line_number\": 63,\n      \"text\": \"          14.3.2.3  The next stage is to proceed with the follow-up\
      \ action\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 64,\n      \"text\": \"\"\
      \n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 65,\n      \"text\": \"          \
      \           a)    report on the findings and conclusions\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n     \
      \ \"source_line_number\": 66,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\"\
      : 67,\n      \"text\": \"                     b)    formulate preventive measures to avoid recurrence\"\n\
      \    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 68,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n\
      \    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 69,\n      \"text\": \"                   \
      \   c)    publicise the findings and the remedial actions taken\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n\
      \      \"source_line_number\": 70,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"\
      source_line_number\": 71,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\"\
      : 72,\n      \"text\": \"          14.4     Employers’ independent incident investigation\"\n    },\n    {\n\
      \      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 73,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"\
      pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 74,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\"\
      : 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 75,\n      \"text\": \"          14.4.1    In case of fatal / dangerous\
      \ occurrence the Employer shall also conduct independent\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n     \
      \ \"source_line_number\": 76,\n      \"text\": \"                      investigation. Contractor and his staff\
      \ shall extend necessary co-operation and testify\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\"\
      : 77,\n      \"text\": \"                  about the accident.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n\
      \      \"source_line_number\": 78,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"\
      source_line_number\": 79,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\"\
      : 80,\n      \"text\": \"          14.4.2   The contractor shall take every effort to preserve the scene of\
      \ accident till the Employer\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 81,\n\
      \      \"text\": \"                  completes the investigation.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n\
      \      \"source_line_number\": 82,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"\
      source_line_number\": 83,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\"\
      : 84,\n      \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"source_line_number\": 85,\n \
      \     \"text\": \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 30,\n      \"source_line_number\": 3,\n      \"text\"\
      : \"\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 30,\n      \"source_line_number\": 4,\n      \"text\": \"14.4.3\
      \     All persons summoned by the Employer in connection to witness recording shall obey\"\n    },\n    {\n\
      \      \"pdf_page\": 30,\n      \"source_line_number\": 5,\n      \"text\": \"          the instructions without\
      \ delay. Any wilful suppression of information by any person shall\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 30,\n\
      \      \"source_line_number\": 6,\n      \"text\": \"        be removed from the site immediately and  / or\
      \ punishable as per relevant penalty\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 30,\n      \"source_line_number\"\

    quote: "{\n  \"clause_id\": \"14.0\",\n  \"fragments\": [\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 27,\n      \"text\": \"\
      14.0     Accident reporting and investigation\\n\\n\\n          14.1     Reporting to Employer\\n\\n\\n  \
      \        14.1.1    All accidents and dangerous occurrences  shall immediately be informed\\n             \
      \      verbally to the Employer. This will enable the Employer to reach to the scene of\\n               \
      \   accident  / dangerous occurrences to monitor/assist any rescue work and/or\\n                     start\
      \ conducting the investigation process so that the evidences are not lost.\\n\\n\\n          14.1.2   Reports\
      \ of all accidents (fatal / injury) and dangerous occurrences shall also be\\n                  sent within\
      \ 24 hours as per format provided in the Employer’s Project SHE\\n                 manual.\\n\\n         \
      \ 14.1.3   No accident   / dangerous occurrences  is exempted from reporting to the\\n                 Employer.\\\
      n\\n\\n          14.1.4   Any wilful delay in verbal and written reporting to the Employer shall be\\n   \
      \               penalised as per relevant clause.\\n\\n\\n          14.2     Reporting to Govt. organisations\"\
      \n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 28,\n      \"text\": \"14.2.1    In addition to the above verbal and\
      \ written reporting to the Employer, as per Rule 210\\n           of BOCWR, notice of any accident to a worker\
      \ at the building or construction site that:\\n\\n\\n          a)   causes loss of life; or\\n\\n        \
      \  b)    disables a worker from working for a period of 48 hours or more immediately\\n                 following\
      \ the accident;\\n\\n           c)     shall forthwith be sent by telegram, telephone, fax, or similar other\
      \ means\\n                including special messenger within four hours in case of fatal accidents and 72\\\
      n              hours in case of other accidents, to:\\n\\n                          i)     the Regional Labour\
      \ Commissioner, wherein the contractor has registered\\n                     the firm/work\\n\\n         \
      \                   ii)    the board with which the worker involved was registered as a beneficiary;\\n\\\
      n                             iii)    Director General and\\n\\n                     iv)    the next of kin\
      \ or other relative of the worker involved in the accident;\\n\\n\\n14.2.2    Further, notice of accident\
      \ shall be sent in respect of an accident which\\n\\n\\n          a)   causes loss of life; or\\n\\n     \
      \     b)    disables the injured worker from work for more than 10 days to\\n\\n                         \
      \ i)     the officer-in-charge of the nearest police station;\\n\\n                            ii)    the\
      \ District Magistrate or, if the District Magistrate by order so desires, to\\n\\n                       \
      \      iii)    the Sub-Divisional Magistrate\\n\\n\\n14.2.3    In case of an accident causing minor injury,\
      \ first-aid shall be administered and the\\n           injured worker shall be immediately transferred to\
      \ a hospital or other place for medical\\n          treatment.\\n\\n14.2.4   Where any accident causing disablement\
      \ that subsequently results in death, notice in\\n           writing of such death, shall be sent to the authorities\
      \ mentioned in clause 14.2.1 and\\n          14.2.2 above within 72 hours of such death.\\n\\n\\n14.2.5  \
      \  Reporting of dangerous occurrences:\\n\\n\\n14.2.5.1  The following classes of dangerous occurrences shall\
      \ be reported to the Inspector\\n         having jurisdiction, whether or not any disablement or death caused\
      \ to the worker,\\n         namely:\\n\\n\\n          a)    collapse or  failure  of  lifting appliances,\
      \  or  hoist,  or conveyors, or  similar\\n              equipment for handling of building or construction\
      \ material or breakage or failure\\n                 of rope, chain or loose gears; or overturning of cranes\
      \ used in construction\\n               work;\\n\\n          b)     falling of objects from height;\\n\\n\
      \           c)    collapse or subsidence of soil, tunnel, pipe lines, any wall, floor, gallery, roof or\\\
      n             any other part of any structure, launching girder, platform, staging, scaffolding or\\n    \
      \        means of access including formwork;\\n\\n          d)    explosion of receiver or vessel used  for\
      \ storage of pressure greater than\\n               atmospheric pressure, of any gas or gases or any liquid\
      \ or solid used as\\n                 building material;\\n\\n          e)     fire and explosion causing\
      \ damage to any place on construction site where\\n                 building workers are employed;\\n\\n \
      \              f)     spillage or leakage of any hazardous substance and damage to their container;\\n\\n\
      \          g)    collapse, capsizing, toppling or collision of transport equipment;\\n\\n          h)    leakage\
      \ or release of harmful toxic gases at the construction site;\\n\\n\\n14.2.6    In case of failure of launching\
      \ girder, lifting appliance, loose gear, hoist or building and\\n          other construction work, machinery\
      \ and transport equipment at a construction site,\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 29,\n      \"text\"\
      : \"such appliances, gear, hoist, machinery or equipment and the site of such occurrence\\n              \
      \         shall, as far as practicable, be kept undisturbed until inspected by the Authorities;\\n\\n\\n \
      \         14.2.7   Every notice given for fatal accidents or dangerous occurrences shall be followed by a\\\
      n                      written report to the concerned Authorities under Section 39 of BOCWA and the\\n  \
      \                   Director General in the specified Form XIV of BOCWR.\\n\\n\\n          14.3     Accident\
      \ investigation\\n\\n\\n          14.3.1   General\\n\\n\\n          14.3.1.1  Investigations  should be \
      \ conducted  in an open and  positive atmosphere  that\\n                 encourages the witnesses to talk\
      \ freely. The primary objective is to ascertain the facts\\n                     with a view to prevent future\
      \ and possibly more serious occurrences\\n\\n\\n          14.3.1.2  Accidents and Dangerous Occurrences which\
      \ result in death, serious injury or serious\\n               damage must be investigated by the Contractor\
      \ immediately to find out the cause of the\\n                   accident/occurrence so that measures can be\
      \ formulated to prevent any recurrence.\\n\\n\\n          14.3.1.3  Near misses and minor accidents should\
      \ also be investigated by the Contractor as\\n                 soon as possible as they are signals  that\
      \ there are inadequacies  in the safety\\n                management system.\\n\\n\\n          14.3.2   Procedure\
      \ of incident investigation\\n\\n\\n          14.3.2.1   It is important after any accident or dangerous occurrence\
      \ that information relating to\\n                    the incident is gathered in an organised way. The following\
      \ steps shall be followed;\\n\\n                     a)    take photographs and make sketches\\n\\n      \
      \               b)   examine involved equipment, workplace  or  material and the environmental\\n        \
      \                  conditions\\n\\n                      c)    interview the injured, eye-witnesses and other\
      \ involved parties\\n\\n                     d)    consult expert opinion where necessary\\n\\n          \
      \           e)    identify the specific contractor or sub-contractor involved.\\n\\n\\n          14.3.2.2\
      \  Having gathered information, it is then necessary to make an analysis of incident\\n\\n               \
      \      a)    establish the chain of events leading to the accident or incident\\n\\n                     b)\
      \    find out at what stage the accident took place\\n\\n                      c)    consider all possible\
      \ causes and the interaction of different factors that led up to\\n                         the accident,\
      \ and identify the most probable cause The cause of an accident\\n                        should never be\
      \ classified as carelessness. The specific act or omission that\\n                      caused the accident\
      \ must be identified.\\n\\n\\n          14.3.2.3  The next stage is to proceed with the follow-up action\\\
      n\\n                     a)    report on the findings and conclusions\\n\\n                     b)    formulate\
      \ preventive measures to avoid recurrence\\n\\n                      c)    publicise the findings and the\
      \ remedial actions taken\\n\\n\\n          14.4     Employers’ independent incident investigation\\n\\n\\\
      n          14.4.1    In case of fatal / dangerous occurrence the Employer shall also conduct independent\\\
      n                      investigation. Contractor and his staff shall extend necessary co-operation and testify\\\
      n                  about the accident.\\n\\n\\n          14.4.2   The contractor shall take every effort to\
      \ preserve the scene of accident till the Employer\\n                  completes the investigation.\"\n  \
      \  },\n    {\n      \"pdf_page\": 30,\n      \"text\": \"14.4.3     All persons summoned by the Employer in\
